en.name: Dahua XVR5104HS 4-Channel DVR
en.shortDescription: 4-channel DVR for analog cameras with 1TB storage included.
en.description:
## Dahua XVR5104HS

A 4-channel digital video recorder compatible with HDCVI, analog, IP and AHD cameras, with a 1 TB hard drive pre-installed.

- 4 camera channels, up to 4MP per channel
- 1 TB included storage
- Remote viewing via DMSS app
